chunks: And by his chain, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

'Learn the Quran, for indeed it will come on the Day of Resurrection to its companion in the form of a beautiful youth, pale of complexion. The Quran will say to him: I am the one who kept you awake during your night, and made you thirsty during your midday hours, and dried your saliva, and caused your tears to flow. I shall be with you wherever you go; and every merchant is behind his own trade, but I am for you today, surpassing the trade of every merchant. And there shall come to you a prestige from God, Mighty and Majestic — so receive glad tidings.'

Then a crown shall be brought and placed upon his head. He shall be given the deed of security in his right hand, and the deed of eternal life in the Gardens of Paradise in his left hand, and he shall be clothed in two garments. Then it shall be said to him: 'Recite and ascend.' And every time he recites a verse, he ascends a level. And his two parents shall be clothed in two garments, if they were believers. Then it shall be said to both of them: 'This is because you taught him the Quran.'

key_terms.تَعَلَّمُوا الْقُرْآنَ: Learn the Quran — a prophetic command to memorize and understand it
key_terms.حُلَّتَيْنِ: Two garments — a symbol of honor and reward in Paradise
key_terms.شَاحِبِ اللَّوْنِ: Pale of complexion — indicating exertion from night vigils and fasting
key_terms.صَاحِبَهُ: Its companion — the devoted reciter and bearer of the Quran
key_terms.كَرَامَةٌ: Prestige/honor — a divine distinction bestowed in the afterlife

ai.seo_question: What reward does the Quran bring to its reciter on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) urges the learning of the Quran by depicting its magnificent intercession on the Day of Resurrection. The Quran itself will appear as a beautiful youth and speak to its devoted reciter, enumerating the hardships of nightly vigils and daytime fasting endured for its sake. This eschatological vision promises the reciter a crown, a deed of security, eternal life, two garments, and continuous spiritual elevation — with his believing parents sharing in the reward, since they were the ones who taught him.

en.hubeali: And by his chain, from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Learn the Quran, for it would be coming on the Day of Judgment to its companion in an image of a beautiful youth, radiant, and the Quran would be saying to him: ‘I am the one whom you held a vigil during your night, and your mouth was thirsty, and dried your throat, and your tears flowed. I shall be with you wherever you go to; and every trader is behind his trade, and I am for you today, from behind a trade with every trader, and there shall be coming to you, a Prestige from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic. Therefore, receive glad tidings, for you would be Given a crown upon your head’.

And he would be Given the (deed of) security in his right hand, and the (deed of) eternal life in the Gardens in his left hand, and he would be Clothed in two garments. Then it would be said to him: ‘Recite and ascend. So every time he recites a Verse, he would ascend a level. And his parents would be Clothed by two Garments, if he was a Momin. Then it would be said to both of them: ‘This is due to both of you teaching him (your son) the Quran’’.
en.sarwar: 3. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: ‘‘The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘

Learn the Holy Quran; on the Day of Judgment it will come to his friends in the form of a most beautiful young person of pale complexion and will speak to his friend saying, “I am the Quran for which you kept awake so often and endured thirst during the heat of midday, dried up your mouth and let your tears flow. I will be with you whenever you will go. Every trader is after his trade. Today I look after the trade of everyone who had a deal with me. Honor will come to you from Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, as good news for you.

The man will receive a crown and peace will be placed on his right hand and eternal life in paradise in his left hand and he will be dressed with two dresses of paradise, then he will be told, ‘Read and climb.’ For each verse that he will read he will climb up one degree and his parents, if they are of the believers, will each receive two dresses of paradise and they will be told that this is for your teaching the Holy Quran to your child.’”
